UH Series Hydraulic Testing Machines
The UH-X and UH-FX series of testing machines are universal testing machines for physical and mechanical testing of various materials with a hydraulic method of force generation. The equipment is designed for high testing throughput and the use of large loads. The machines of this series are an excellent option for solving production and technological problems in various areas of industry.
Features
Wide range of applicable loads. It is possible to supply standard equipment with a capacity of 200, 300, 500, 600 1000 kN, as well as especially powerful equipment up to 4000 kN for tensile, compression and bending tests.
«TRAPEZIUM X» software. The software allows you to fully control the testing process using a PC.
Open front type clamps (UH-FX only). The standard equipment of the UH-FX series machine includes front-type hydraulic clamps.
Liquid crystal touch control panel. The testing machine is equipped with an LCD panel to control and monitor the testing process. The S-S curve during the test is displayed on the LCD screen in real time.
Two accuracy classes 1 and 0.5. The equipment is available in two accuracy classes with an error of 1% and 0.5%.
Highly rigid frame. The rigidity of the main frame guarantees the reliability and trouble-free operation of the equipment. It is possible to supply equipment with different frame heights to increase the working test area.
Traverse movement speed up to 450 mm/min. Ability to set different loading speeds.
Security. Overload protection. Emergency stop switch. Piston stroke limiter.
Large selection of additional accessories. Devices for various types of tests (tension, compression and bending). Additional accessories (extensometers, thermal chambers).
